module_reviews.assessment: Sponsor references and two baseline PNG blobs are deleted. New LAN discovery documentation describes opt-in local discovery and credential trust boundaries; no new executable asset.
Response/body/WebSocket compression and LAN TXT options only. DNS module moves indirect to direct without a version/source change; 112 module versions and go.sum are unchanged.

Negotiated gzip/zstd wraps the existing downstream response writer; no new network destination, file write, credential source or execution primitive. CORS request-header enumeration preserves existing origin policy.

New browser sends DNS questions to 224.0.0.251 and ff02::fb port 5353 on selected interfaces. Per-interface records/TTL/cache bounds and cancellation control resources; displayed endpoints are not connected to by the CLI. Advertisements remove management hints and contain capability/identity metadata, not credential values.

Schema 7 lets existing active interceptors omit request bodies; usage selection UUID and failure classification pass to existing configured sinks. No plugin loader/source/installation change, new destination or added permission.

Compression/decoding operates on existing request/response bodies and targets; one plaintext retry retains the same URL. Structured-output/tool-choice changes only transform requested model payloads. WebSocket changes negotiate compression on existing sockets. Tests use local test servers or injected transports; none executed.

Commentary markers, content block envelopes, terminal events and usage fields are transformed in memory. Attachment helper constructs inline/file JSON; data URLs are parsed without fetching URLs. No execution/download sink added.

Selection IDs are generated and cleared per existing scheduler attempt; cancellation and stream-truncation classifications affect existing delivery/retry paths. Usage record additions introduce no new recipient or persistence path.

classification_changes.install_behavior: No new module/version/source or install hook. Existing module was already required in approved build graph; go mod download does not execute package scripts; central CGO_ENABLED=0 go build does not invoke go generate.
